title: Single-complex normalization of the explicit truncated counit
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes, with the shared derived categories of structure-module sheaves, and $q\in\mathbf Z$. Write $F=g_*$, $L=Lg^*$ and $R=Rg_*$. Let $S_X^q$ denote the complex concentrated in degree $q$, $H_X^q$ its cohomology functor, and $E_X:H_X^qS_X^q\simeq\mathrm{id}$, so $E_X(N):H_X^q(S_X^q N)\simeq N$. For a module $M$ on $T$, define $u_{g,q,M}:S_S^q(FM)\to R(S_T^q M)$ by the inverse termwise single/direct-image comparison followed by the selected right-derived unit [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Let $c_{g,q,K}:H_S^q(RK)\to F(H_T^qK)$ be the explicitly transposed upper-truncation counit [def-weil-pbc-truncated-counit-edge]. Then $H_S^q(u_{g,q,M})\,c_{g,q,S_T^qM}=E_S(FM)\,F(E_T(M)^{-1})$ in diagrammatic composition order. The pullback comparison and adjunction are the pinned ones of [lem-weil-pbc-derived-pullback-top-cohomology, def-pc-derived-base-change-map, lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction].

source.place: Tags 079W, 0BKJ and 0D5X; derived.tex Tags 08J5 and 06XS. Agent-derived normalization of the explicit maps.

proof.text: For any C at most q and any d:L C -> K, naturality of truncation and the Hom-bijection into an object at least q identify the counit edge precomposed with Hq of the derived transpose of d with the ordinary transpose of kappa_C^{-1} Hq(d).
Apply the proved arbitrary-degree single transpose to the ordinary module counit. The transpose is the single direct-image comparison because the ordinary transpose of that counit is the identity.

The top projection of a single complex is the single of the inverse single/homology identification, by injectivity of Hq on maps from degree-at-most-q to degree-at-least-q objects. Naturality of the left-derived counit and the termwise single comparison therefore computes kappa on this single complex.

Use the ordinary counit as the module map. Its ordinary transpose is the identity, so the derived transpose is u_{g,q,M}. The preceding kappa calculation and the ordinary adjunction naturality give the claimed equation after cancelling the single/homology isomorphisms.

mathlib_searches.results: Adjunction.derivedη_fac_app and derived-unit factorization lemmas; no fixed integer-degree tensor comparison/counit equation.
General homEquiv naturality and inverse identities, used in the proof; no normalized derived-module single equation.

The existing top cohomology Hom-bijection and derived unit suffice for the proof; the earlier canonical single transpose is only degree zero and uses a different comparison. No duplicate of the new integer-degree equation.

lean.statement: theorem topEdgeSingleDirectImageMap_counit {T S : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S) (q : ℤ) (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) : let HS := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor.{w, u, u + 1} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) q let ES := DerivedCategory.singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) q let ET := DerivedCategory.singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) q HS.map (topEdgeSingleDirectImageMap g q M) ≫ topEdgeTruncatedCounit g q ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) q).obj M) = ES.hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj M) ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map (ET.inv.app M)
